events.text:
Migration is paused at 200 of 400 records. Batches 6–10 were not run because continuing would save more incorrect phone numbers.

**Done:** Batches 1–5 (200 records) are in the new CRM. Batches 1, 2, 4, and 5 had no validation notes. Batch 3 reported that the old CRM stored phones without country codes, and the new CRM prefixed them with +1. 31 of the first 120 records are overseas customers, so those numbers are wrong. Batches 4–5 were already in flight when that note came back and likely have the same issue. I do not have the correct numbers, so I did not change any phones.

**Not done:** Batches 6–10 (200 records).

**Already in use:** 14 sales users opened customer records in the new CRM in the last 24 hours, so some may already be relying on bad numbers.

I need a decision before I continue: fix the prefix logic and re-migrate, correct the overseas numbers another way, or proceed and accept the +1 prefix.
